float.parser: none, left, right; horizontal physical sides only.
float.cascade: Non-inherited; CSS-wide/var/rollback; ignored on flex/grid items.
float.used: Source-ordered margin-box exclusions with per-line opportunities, shrink-to-fit and independent float formatting contexts. Horizontal CSS2 subset; no shape-outside or pagination.

clear.used: Clearance below earlier floats in the shared block formatting context, breaking parent/child collapse when necessary. No logical axes.

table-layout.used: Bounded automatic min/max-content column allocation with spans, or fixed declared-width first-row/column sizing. Horizontal CSS2 subset, no pagination or full WPT claim.

border-collapse.used: Separate cell borders or shared collapsed edges resolved by hidden/width/style/origin/source precedence. No paged fragments.

border-spacing.parser: One or two nonnegative lengths; percentages rejected.
border-spacing.used: Horizontal/vertical separate-border gaps including outer gaps; ignored in collapse.

caption-side.used: Caption blocks above/below the table grid within the margin-bearing wrapper; horizontal writing only.

empty-cells.used: Suppresses empty cell background/border only in separate-border model.

grid-tracks.parser: Finite fixed/percentage/auto/min-content/max-content/fr, minmax, fit-content, line names, positive integer repeat and fixed auto-fill/auto-fit. No subgrid/masonry, nested repeat or grid/grid-template shorthands.
grid-tracks.cascade: Non-inherited; wide/var/rollback; invalid declarations rejected atomically.
grid-tracks.computed: Typed breadths and bounded expandable track lists; percentages retained.
grid-tracks.used: Explicit and implicit tracks, phased placement, spanning intrinsic growth, flexible free-space allocation, content alignment and auto-fit collapse. 256 tracks per axis; oversized requests clamp with diagnostics. Finite horizontal Level 1 subset, no full WPT conformance claim.

grid-areas.parser: Rectangular equal-width quoted rows and none; nonrectangular named areas rejected.
grid-areas.used: Explicit area extent and generated name-start/name-end lines; grid-area placement.

grid-line.parser: auto, nonzero lexical signed integer, custom line/area name and positive span with optional name; grid-row/column/area atomically expand.
grid-line.computed: Typed line/span; negative explicit-grid indexing retained.
grid-line.used: Order-modified explicit and auto placement with overlapping explicit areas and bounded implicit extension. Anchored named spans search matching lines; unanchored named spans diagnose an integer-span fallback. Positioned children never occupy cells or contribute sizing.

grid-flow.parser: row/column with optional dense, or dense.
grid-flow.used: Phased locked-axis placement followed by sparse cursor or dense hole filling; capped occupancy searches report diagnostics.

flex-direction.parser: row, row-reverse, column, column-reverse; flex-flow resets direction and wrap atomically.
flex-direction.computed: Typed physical horizontal-writing axes; vertical writing modes absent.
flex-direction.used: Order-modified flex lines, direction RTL mapping and reversed axes; no grid, vertical writing or external WPT claim.

flex-wrap.used: Hypothetical outer-size line collection with internal gaps, reversed cross axis; no visibility:collapse struts or fragmentation.

flex-number.parser: Finite nonnegative numbers; numeric math and exceptional values absent.
flex-number.used: CSS flexible length freezing, scaled shrink and sums below one; no animation or external WPT conformance claim.

flex-basis.parser: auto, content and finite nonnegative length/percentage/math; intrinsic sizing keywords absent. flex supports none/auto, numeric factors and basis.
flex-basis.used: Definite percentage basis or content fallback, intrinsic text/image basis, automatic main minimum and min/max freeze iterations. Intrinsic flex widths use the published CSS 9.9.1.1 ideal algorithm, not an assertion of its web-compatible replacement; cyclic percentage decorations and multi-line column intrinsic cross sizing remain partial. No orthogonal items, aspect-ratio property or general intrinsic-size keyword grammar.

flex-size.parser: Min auto, max none, finite nonnegative length/percentage/math only; intrinsic sizing keywords and anchor-size absent.
flex-size.used: Required flex main/cross constraints and block/positioned clamping; automatic content minimum only on non-scrollable flex main axes. Not the general 8.15 sizing conformance umbrella.

order.parser: Signed 32-bit lexical integer; integer math absent.
order.used: Stable order-modified flex layout and paint/hit order; no grid and no keyboard navigation implementation.

flex-align.parser: Finite start/end, flex-start/end, center, normal, stretch, auto on self, self-start/end, first baseline and applicable distribution keywords; safe/unsafe positional alignment. place-items/self/content expand atomically. Lone justify-items legacy normalizes to normal; legacy center/left/right, last baseline and general alignment absent.
flex-align.used: Flex/grid item auto margins, track/line distribution, stretch reflow and horizontal first-row baselines; safe negative-space fallback and RTL placement. Column flex, grid inline-axis and align-content baseline use diagnosed start fallbacks. No vertical writing, last-baseline groups or full CSS Align/WPT claim.

flex-gap.parser: normal or finite nonnegative length/percentage/math; gap atomically expands row/column.
flex-gap.used: Flex item/line and grid track gutters, definite percentages, zero cyclic intrinsic contribution with diagnostic. Cyclic grid row gaps resolve once against the intrinsic height without feeding overflow back into sizing. No multicolumn.

overflow.parser: visible, hidden, clip, scroll and auto; one/two physical-axis shorthand keywords. Logical axes and overflow-clip-margin absent.
overflow.cascade: Non-inherited typed axes; atomic shorthand, CSS-wide/var/origin/layer rollback.
overflow.computed: Coupled visible becomes auto and clip becomes hidden when the opposite axis establishes a scroll container.
overflow.used: Padding-edge axis clips on block/flex/atomic inline-flex boxes, nested document-owned bounded offsets, wheel chaining, click/drag panel overlay tracks, root/body viewport propagation and positioned containing-block clip ancestry. Ordinary non-replaced inline overflow, sticky, snap, styled/reserved gutters, root scrollbar UI, transforms, writing modes and external WPT conformance remain absent.

position.parser: static, relative, absolute and fixed; sticky deferred to 8.19.
position.cascade: Non-inherited typed value; wide/var/origin/layer handling and out-of-flow inline/inline-flex blockification.
position.computed: Keyword enum; no transforms, anchors or writing modes.
position.used: CSS2 horizontal positioning, padding-box and first/last inline-fragment containing blocks, initial/viewport fixed space and flex static alignment. Split inline continuations share construction identity. Positioned flex uses the common intrinsic and sized formatters. No floats, tables, grid, transforms or paged media.

inset.parser: auto or finite signed length/percentage/math; anchor functions and logical inset properties absent.
inset.cascade: Non-inherited sides; atomic four-side inset shorthand with wide/var/rollback.
inset.computed: Typed length-or-auto; font/viewport/container units computed, percentages retained.
inset.used: CSS2 relative offsets and absolute/fixed horizontal/vertical equations, static-position fallback, shrink-to-fit, opposing insets and auto margins. Horizontal writing only; normal-flow percentage height remains partial.

z-index.parser: auto or signed 32-bit lexical integer; integer math and exceptional values absent.
z-index.computed: Auto distinct from integer zero; static flex items accept integer context levels, other static boxes ignore them.
z-index.used: Root, positioned and flex-item integer contexts are atomic; CSS2 Appendix E phases with flex order-modified atomic item painting, escaped auto descendants, negative/zero/positive levels and source-order ties. Floats and future context-creating effects absent; fixed auto follows CSS2 rather than modern unconditional contexts.

white-space.parser: normal, nowrap, pre, pre-wrap, pre-line, break-spaces or supported collapse/wrap pairs; trimming, discard and preserve-spaces rejected.
white-space.cascade: Atomically expands both pinned longhands, with CSS-wide, var, inheritance and origin/layer rollback.
white-space.computed: Typed white-space-collapse and text-wrap-mode; white-space-trim remains unsupported.
white-space.used: Horizontal UAX #14 over normalized logical inline text, protected shaping clusters, preserved breaks, hanging and default tabs. OpenType script/language shaping; no paragraph bidi, dictionary segmentation or advanced Text 4 tailoring.

white-space-collapse.parser: collapse, preserve, preserve-breaks and break-spaces; discard and preserve-spaces rejected.
white-space-collapse.cascade: Inherited typed value; text/pseudo/anonymous boxes, CSS-wide/var/rollback.
white-space-collapse.used: CSS spaces/tabs/LF and CR-as-space, cross-node collapse, preserved geometry, trailing trim/hang. Conservative Han/Kana segment-break deletion; language/script/font-dependent tailoring and bidi deferred.

text-wrap-mode.cascade: Inherited typed value; CSS-wide/var/rollback and atomic white-space expansion.
text-wrap-mode.used: UAX #14 soft opportunities with buffered greedy fitting; forced breaks override nowrap. No break-all, overflow-wrap, hyphenation dictionaries, bidi or writing modes.

text-fill.parser: Existing finite Color 4/5 subset; no quirky hex colors, stroking or advanced color gaps resolved.
text-fill.cascade: Inherited currentcolor and wide/var/origin/layer tests; no external conformance gate.
text-fill.computed: Currentcolor is retained for inheritance; authoritative resolved fill is independent of color/borders/background.
text-fill.used: Baseline-positioned indexed OpenType glyphs for text, generated text, list markers and image alt text; exact selected/fallback outline faces, sRGB framebuffer, no color-font paint or strokes.

box-sizing.parser: content-box and border-box, including the exact WHATWG -webkit-box-sizing legacy alias.
box-sizing.cascade: Alias shares canonical identity, priority, var and rollback; local tests only.
box-sizing.computed: Specified keyword; no animation or full CSSOM.
box-sizing.used: Normal-flow, absolute/fixed and flex content/decorated sizes, including physical min/max flex prerequisites. Flex base calculation ignores the zero content floor before hypothetical clamping. General replaced constraint/aspect-ratio conformance remains 8.15.

content.parser: Only normal, none, strings and untyped attr(name); no images, counters, quotes, alt text or element().
content.cascade: Only before/after text pseudo boxes; no page-margin/replacement model.
content.computed: Bounded text list; typed attr(), counters and full content computation absent.
content.used: Horizontal text only; generated images/markers/page margins absent.

color.parser: Finite Color 4/5 subset; no device-cmyk(), light-dark(), contrast-color(), custom profiles or exceptional numbers.
color.cascade: Local origin/layer/var/currentcolor tests; no external conformance gate.
color.computed: System colors use a fixed light palette; dependency/serialization and exceptional-value gates remain.
color.used: sRGB byte framebuffer; no HDR or CSS perceptual gamut mapping.

border-color.parser: Finite Color 4/5 subset; border image-1D alternative, advanced Color 5 and exceptional numbers absent.
border-color.cascade: Local edge/origin/layer/var/currentcolor tests; no external conformance gate.
border-color.computed: Color only, no one-dimensional image function; fixed light system palette and incomplete CSSOM.
border-color.used: sRGB byte framebuffer and basic box edges; no HDR, perceptual gamut mapping or border gradients.

image.parser: Only none; image functions, URLs and multiple layers absent.
image.cascade: Single stored value; no layered image model.

display.parser: block, inline, list-item, none, flex/inline-flex, grid/inline-grid, table/inline-table and all CSS2 table-internal/caption keywords; no multi-keyword/ruby/math.
display.cascade: Local cascade with flex/grid-item, float and positioned blockification; anonymous table/row/group/cell fixup preserves real identity.
display.computed: Single enum and hypothetical static-position inline flag; no general inner/outer pair or inlinification model.
display.used: Horizontal block/inline, floats with per-line exclusions, flex/grid and atomic inline containers; table min/max and fixed columns, bounded spans, row heights/baselines/captions and border models. Tables cap 512 rows, 128 columns, 65536 slots and 1000000px per used size/contribution with diagnostics. No pagination or external WPT claim.

direction.cascade: Inherited, CSS-wide/var/origin/layer handling; excluded from all as required by CSS Cascade.
direction.computed: Inherited direction enum; unicode-bidi and logical box properties absent.
direction.used: Containing direction selects overconstrained block margins and logical start/end text alignment; flex main/cross axes, reversal, auto margins and logical alignment map RTL. No bidi text, ordinary RTL inline flow or vertical writing modes.

text-align-all.parser: Only left, right, center, start and end; justify, strings and match-parent deferred.
text-align-all.cascade: Inherited typed value, CSS-wide/var/origin/layer handling; local tests only.
text-align-all.computed: Logical keywords retained and resolved using the block container direction.
text-align-all.used: Horizontal line alignment including last and br-ended lines; no justification, bidi or writing modes.

text-align-last.cascade: Inherited, reset atomically by text-align; CSS-wide/var handling.
text-align-last.used: Last lines follow supported text-align-all; independent last-line alignment and justification deferred.

text-align.parser: Only left, right, center, start and end; unsupported justification is rejected.
text-align.cascade: Atomically expands text-align-all and resets text-align-last, including variables and CSS-wide values.
text-align.used: Horizontal line alignment; justification, bidi and advanced text deferred.

alignment-baseline.computed: Table alignment keyword; no alternative script baseline metrics.
alignment-baseline.used: Selected/fallback faces share the alphabetic baseline; table-cell middle alignment uses allocated row height. Non-baseline inline alignment diagnoses baseline fallback.

baseline-shift.parser: Only numeric zero; lengths, percentages and shift keywords deferred.
baseline-shift.used: No baseline shift; advanced vertical alignment deferred.

baseline-source.used: Replaced images use the bottom margin edge; atomic inline-flex/grid export first item baselines and inline-table exports its first row baseline excluding captions. First/last selection remains partial.

vertical-align.parser: baseline, top, middle and bottom; offsets, sub/super and first/last deferred.
vertical-align.cascade: Atomically expands and resets the three pinned-spec longhands, including CSS-wide and variables.
vertical-align.computed: Physical table-cell alignment, zero shift and auto source.
vertical-align.used: Table cells align baseline/top/middle/bottom within allocated row/span height. Non-baseline inline alignment explicitly diagnoses a baseline fallback; advanced metrics absent.

font-size.parser: Finite lengths/math/size keywords; math keyword and additional Values 4/5 forms absent.
font-size.cascade: Local inheritance/var/origin tests; no external conformance gate.
font-size.computed: UA medium=16px; 512 CSS px cap; selected-face ch/ex/cap/ic and corresponding root metrics.
font-size.used: Shared selected-face OpenType shaping and exact indexed raster scale; no full browser font parity.

font-family.parser: Family lists/generic names; no complete CSSOM serialization gate.
font-family.cascade: Inherited list selects the same document font context used by layout/paint and contextual units.
font-family.computed: UA initial is sans-serif; typed list retained.
font-family.used: Document-owned @font-face aliases, static descriptors/unicode ranges and TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2 sources precede installed fontdb families; indexed shaping/raster and outline fallback. Conditional resource loading is separate from relayout. Specialized generics approximate sans-serif; timed font-display, variation axes, collections in downloads and advanced descriptors are partial/unsupported.

font-weight.parser: Numbers 1..1000, normal/bold/bolder/lighter and finite number math.
font-weight.cascade: Local relative/inherited tests; no external conformance gate.
font-weight.computed: Local relative-weight rules; no exhaustive external tests.
font-weight.used: Static integer @font-face descriptor matching with CSS asymmetric 400..500 search, or installed fontdb matching; synthesize bold only for a nonbold actual face. Variable default instance only, no descriptor ranges or axis selection.

font-style.parser: Only normal, italic, oblique; no oblique angle or left/right.
font-style.cascade: Local inherited tests; no external conformance gate.
font-style.used: Document @font-face normal/italic/oblique descriptors and installed fontdb face matching; synthesize slant only when the actual selected/fallback face is upright. Oblique-angle descriptors unsupported.

line-height.parser: Finite nonnegative number/length/percentage/math and normal subset.
line-height.cascade: Local inherited tests; no external conformance gate.
line-height.computed: Normal retained; lh/rlh use selected-face line metrics.
line-height.used: Primary struts and actual fallback runs contribute ascent/descent and signed half-leading, including zero/negative leading and glyph overflow. No advanced vertical alignment.

size.parser: Only auto and finite nonnegative lengths/percentages/math; intrinsic sizing keywords/anchor-size absent.
size.cascade: Local wide/var tests; no external conformance gate.
size.computed: Typed lengths; no full intrinsic sizing or percentage stage model.
size.used: CSS2 normal-flow block/replaced sizes and absolute/fixed shrink-to-fit/inset equations; percentage heights resolve against definite containing content/padding heights. Indefinite percentage-height, min/max and general intrinsic sizing remain partial; advanced layouts absent.

container-type.parser: Only normal, size, inline-size; scroll-state and combinations absent.
container-type.cascade: Local named/anonymous query and var tests; no external conformance gate.
container-type.computed: Keyword enum; style/scroll-state query semantics absent.
container-type.used: Bounded horizontal block-size feedback; no advanced formatting-context containment.

container-name.parser: none or bounded custom-ident list (256 tokens); no external grammar gate.
container-name.cascade: Local name/inheritance/query tests; no external conformance gate.
container-name.computed: Ordered identifier list; style/scroll-state queries absent.

margin.parser: Auto and finite lengths/percentages/math; anchor-size() absent.
margin.cascade: Atomic side/four-value/wide/var/origin/layer handling; local tests only.
margin.computed: Typed length-or-auto values retain auto and unresolved percentages, separately from used margins.
margin.used: CSS2 block equations, adjoining normal-flow vertical margin sets and absolute/fixed inset equations including horizontal/vertical auto margins. Normal-flow inline/vertical auto margins are zero; sliced inline margins do not expand vertical lines. Flex/grid/logical layouts absent.

padding.parser: Finite nonnegative lengths/percentages/math subset; remaining Values forms absent.
padding.cascade: Local side/four-value/wide tests; no external conformance gate.
padding.used: Horizontal block/replaced boxes and sliced inline fragments. Non-replaced vertical padding decorates without enlarging line boxes; writing modes and advanced layout absent.

border-width.parser: Finite nonnegative lengths and thin/medium/thick; hairline and additional Values forms absent.
border-width.cascade: Local side/four-value/wide tests; no external conformance gate.
border-width.computed: UA widths 1/3/5px; none/hidden zeroing, no spec snapping gate.
border-width.used: Block/replaced edges and per-line inline edge slicing; non-replaced vertical borders do not enlarge lines. No advanced border geometry.

border-style.cascade: Local side/four-value/wide tests; no external conformance gate.
border-style.used: Basic edge paint; no full border-style conformance gate.

all.parser: Five existing CSS-wide keywords only; snapshot revert-rule absent.
all.cascade: Expands only implemented longhands; does not implement snapshot's unsupported properties.
all.used: Only supported property's finite layout/paint subset.

background.parser: One color and/or none; layers, sizing, positioning, repeat, attachment and boxes absent.
background.cascade: Resets only supported background-color/image; other longhand and reset targets absent.
background.computed: Only color and None image stored.

font.parser: Finite style/weight/size/line-height/family subset; variants, stretch and system-font shorthand absent.
font.cascade: Expands/resets only five supported fields; other spec longhand/reset targets absent.
font.used: Document-owned web fonts over shared system/bundled discovery, indexed OpenType shaping and fallback; advanced descriptors/timed font-display, color-font paint and variation axes remain unsupported/partial.

container.parser: Names with optional size/inline-size/normal type; scroll-state absent.
container.cascade: Resets both supported fields; local tests only.

border.parser: Finite width/style/color subset; hairline, groove/ridge/inset/outset and additional colors absent.
border.cascade: Supported physical edges only; border-image reset targets absent.
border.used: Basic box edges only; no full border paint conformance.
